blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Wednesday took a swipe at Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano’s credibility after the latter described him as having influence over various government agencies amid the controversy over alleged ghost projects in Taguig City. In a post on X, Lacson quoted Cayetano as saying that he had become “Chief Justice Lacson, Prosecutor Lacson, DOJ Lacson, persecutor Lacson” and “Secretary Lacson,” who was supposedly “calling the shots.” Lacson said, “If this were coming from someone credible, I’d take it as a compliment.” His statement came after Cayetano in a Facebook livestream on Tuesday, questioned […]...
